name: weed-plugins
description: Weed's Claude Code harness - one repo, per-loop plugins

plugins.name: weed-harness
plugins.description: Shared loop runtime every weed loop plugin builds on - loop-report (live progress page; Artifact on Claude Code, Orca delivery elsewhere), interview-report and autocode-board (page views), model-routing (Codex-side model/effort tiers), loop-gates (unlazy completion discipline) - plus the Claude Code HUD and opt-in hooks

plugins.name: matt-loop
plugins.description: Matt loop, Claude Code edition - matt-auto on the built-ins (fork delegate, plugin agents, Workflow or /batch, /code-review, /loop, Artifact page) with an execution plan gate, PR babysitting, conflict resolution, and the vendored Matt Pocock skills. Requires weed-harness 5.0+

plugins.name: auto-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous loop, Claude Code edition - autocode (hypothesis-driven parallel code improvement) with an Artifact experiment board; kept changes end as one PR. Requires weed-harness 5.0+
